Offline visualization dependencies:

- D3 7.9.0, ISC license: https://github.com/d3/d3
- Country GeoJSON converted from world-atlas 2 countries-110m (Natural Earth public-domain geometry): https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas

Geographic outlines are visualization geometry only. Country assignments to songs must come from sourced artist/band metadata in artifacts/artist_regions.json, never from language inference.
